lines.zh: : 好痛……

lines.en: I quickly kneel down beside Futaba to make sure she’s still alive. Once I confirm she is, my mind navigates elsewhere.
lines.zh: 我赶紧跪到 Futaba 身边，确认她还活着。一确认完，我的思绪就飘到别处去了。

lines.en: Ahh, pantyhose. What a wonderful invention.
lines.zh: 啊，连裤袜。多么了不起的发明。

lines.en: Though, I have to say, I think I’d prefer her without them at this particular moment in time.
lines.zh: 不过我得说，此时此刻我倒更希望她没穿。

lines.en: But nonetheless, this is an image I will ingrain into my mind.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，这幅画面我会永远刻进脑子里。
: Sensei……你吓死我了……

lines.en: s "Sorry. I didn’t even realize you were here. I thought you had
lines.zh: s "抱歉。我根本不知道你在这儿。我没在前台看到你，还以为你

lines.en: off when I didn’t see you at the front desk."
lines.zh: 已经走了。"

lines.en: : Are you okay? That was quite the fall.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？摔得可不轻。

lines.en: : I think so. My butt kind of hurts but other than that I think I’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 应该没事。屁股有点疼，除此之外我想我没事。

lines.en: : Want me to rub it for you?
lines.zh: : 要我帮你揉揉吗？
: 放松。我开玩笑的。
: {i}这算什么玩笑啊？……{/i}

lines.en: : You should really be careful from now on, you know. If you landed on your neck you could have died.
lines.zh: : 你以后真的得小心点，知道吗。要是你脖子着地，搞不好会死。

lines.en: : I know, I know...This happens so often that you’d think I’d be prepared for it by now.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道……这事发生得太频繁了，你大概会觉得我早该有准备了。

lines.en: : How often do you fall off stepladders? I can’t imagine this being a majorly recurring event.
lines.zh: : 你多久从梯子上摔一次啊？我实在想象不出这能是常有的事。

lines.en: : I don’t mean just stepladders, obviously.
lines.zh: : 我当然不只是指梯子。

lines.en: : I’m just sort of clumsy in general...
lines.zh: : 我只是……总体上就笨手笨脚的……

lines.en: : That’s nothing to feel bad about. We all have our moments.
lines.zh: : 这有什么好难为情的。谁都有这种时候。

lines.en: s "This one time in [high_school], I tripped and knocked over an
lines.zh: s "有一次在 [high_school]，我绊了一下，打翻了整整一箱

lines.en: entire case of dead frogs during a science lab."
lines.zh: 实验课上要用的死青蛙。"

lines.en: : Then to make things worse, the teacher slipped on one and landed flat on her face.
lines.zh: : 更糟的是，老师踩到一只，脸朝下摔了个结实。
: 那……有点恶心……

lines.en: s "I know, right? What was even grosser was that she broke three
lines.zh: s "是吧？更恶心的是她摔断了三颗

lines.en: of her teeth and needed facial reconstruction surgery."
lines.zh: 牙，还得做面部重建手术。"

lines.en: : Is this...supposed to make me feel better?
lines.zh: : 这……是为了让我好受点吗？
: 看情况。有用吗？
: 嗯……也许有一点点。

lines.en: : Well I’m glad. Because none of that story was true and now I feel bad about lying to you.
lines.zh: : 那我很高兴。因为那个故事没有一句是真的，我现在为骗了你感到愧疚。

lines.en: : You made all of that up off the top of your head?
lines.zh: : 那些都是你现编的？

lines.en: : Yeah. I didn’t know where I was going with it at first but it just sort of filled itself in.
lines.zh: : 嗯。一开始我也不知道要往哪儿说，但它自己就把细节填满了。

lines.en: : I guess that’s to be expected from someone like you.
lines.zh: : 我想换作是你，这也算意料之中吧。

lines.en: : What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你这话什么意思？

lines.en: : N-Nothing in particular...Just that you’re really smart and creative and stuff.
lines.zh: : 没——没什么特别的意思……只是说你真的很聪明、很有创造力之类的。

lines.en: : I wish I could be as creative as you.
lines.zh: : 我要是能像你这么有创造力就好了。

lines.en: : Oh come on, I’m sure you can do a million times better than some dead frogs and a messed up teacher.
lines.zh: : 拜托，我敢肯定你能比什么死青蛙、惨老师的强上一百万倍。

lines.en: "Hmm...Now that I think about it, I remember Sensei saying something
lines.zh: "嗯……现在想想，我记得 Sensei 在他那本

lines.en: about how Futaba gets caught in daydreams in that journal of his."
lines.zh: 日记里说过，Futaba 总会陷进白日梦里。"

lines.en: Maybe I can talk to her about those?
lines.zh: 要不我拿这个跟她聊聊？

lines.en: : Say, you daydream a lot, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 话说，你经常做白日梦吧？
: ……我有吗？
: 我还真没注意过。

lines.en: : Yup. You zone out in class every once in a while. It’s not a big deal, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你在课上偶尔会走神。不过也不是什么大事。

lines.en: : What I’m getting at is why not try turning those daydreams into something creative?
lines.zh: : 我想说的是，为什么不试着把那些白日梦变成点有创造力的东西呢？

lines.en: : Do you mean like...writing a book?
lines.zh: : 你是说像……写一本书那样？

lines.en: : Sure. A book, poetry, maybe even painting.
lines.zh: : 对。一本书、诗，甚至画画也行。

lines.en: : I’m not really that good with my hands...I don’t think painting would work out.
lines.zh: : 我手不太巧……我觉得画画大概不行。

lines.en: : Well then how about one of the first two? I could help you if you need it.
lines.zh: : 那前两种里挑一个怎么样？需要的话我可以帮你。

lines.en: : It’ll be my way of apologizing for inadvertently causing you to fall off a stepladder and flash me.
lines.zh: : 就当是我为害你从梯子上摔下来、还走光给我看而道歉吧。
: 走光？

lines.en: : You...are aware that I can see up your skirt, correct?
lines.zh: : 你……知道我能从你裙子里看进去，对吧？

lines.en: Ah, I guess she didn’t realize it after all.
lines.zh: 啊，看来她果然没意识到。

lines.en: : Why didn’t you say anything sooner?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不早说？

lines.en: Who in their right mind would do such a thing?
lines.zh: 脑子正常的人谁会干这种事啊？

lines.en: : I’m sorry you had to see me that way...
lines.zh: : 很抱歉让你看到我那个样子……

lines.en: : There’s no need to apologize. It’s not like I could really see your underwear through the pantyhose.
lines.zh: : 不用道歉。隔着连裤袜，我又看不真切你的内裤。

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s the issue here...
lines.zh: : 我觉得问题不在这里……

lines.en: : So, what do you say about the whole ‘harnessing your creative vision' thing?
lines.zh: : 那么，关于「把你的创意想象利用起来」这件事，你怎么说？

lines.en: : I didn’t hear an answer before you started collecting yourself.
lines.zh: : 你在开始整理仪容之前，我还没听到回答呢。
: 你……真的觉得我可以吗？

lines.en: : Well you won’t know until you try, right?
lines.zh: : 不试试怎么知道，对吧？

lines.en: : You’ve really never tried writing a book or poem or anything like that?
lines.zh: : 你真的从没试过写书、写诗之类的？

lines.en: : Well, of course I’ve tried, but...
lines.zh: : 当然试过了，可是……

lines.en: : Nothing ever really comes out how I want it to.
lines.zh: : 写出来的东西从来都不是我想要的样子。

lines.en: : Well then let me help you. I’m your teacher.
lines.zh: : 那就让我来帮你。我是你的老师。

lines.en: Or, at least I’m {i}pretending{/i} to be your teacher. I don’t really think I’m qualified...
lines.zh: : 或者说，我至少是在{i}假装{/i}当你的老师。我真不觉得自己够格……

lines.en: : But...aren’t you busy with the rest of the class?
lines.zh: : 可是……你不是还要忙班里其他人吗？

lines.en: : You’re just as important as everyone else, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 你和其他人一样重要，Futaba。
: 怎么了？
: 不，我只是——

lines.en: : ...Not really used to hearing you call me by my first name yet.
lines.zh: : ……还不太习惯听你直呼我的名字。

lines.en: : Heh~ It’s kind of like we’re real friends...
lines.zh: : 呵~ 感觉我们像真正的朋友一样……

lines.en: : That’s right. And friends help each other out when they need us.
lines.zh: : 没错。而朋友会在彼此需要的时候互相帮忙。

lines.en: : And so as your teacher {i}and{/i} your friend, I’m giving you an extra homework assignment.
lines.zh: : 所以，作为你的老师{i}兼{/i}朋友，我要给你布置一项额外的作业。

lines.en: : Extra homework? What do I need to do?
lines.zh: : 额外作业？我要做什么？

lines.en: : Write me something. Anything. A poem, a short story...But it needs to be about something you feel.
lines.zh: : 写点东西给我。什么都行。一首诗、一篇短篇……但它得是关于你真正在意的东西。

lines.en: : It can be a daydream, a secret, whatever. But I’m going to need it done by Affection level 10.
lines.zh: : 可以是白日梦，可以是秘密，随便什么。但我需要你在好感度 10 级之前交给我。
: 在……什么时候之前？

lines.en: : Sorry. I meant to say that I need it done soon.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我的意思是，你得尽快写完。

lines.en: : Hehe~ Okay. I’ll do it. I can’t promise it will be any good, though.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 好。我会写的。不过我不保证写得多好。

lines.en: Futaba and I spend the next few minutes cleaning up the books she knocked over when she fell.
lines.zh: 接下来的几分钟，我和 Futaba 一起收拾她摔倒时碰掉的书。

lines.en: Before I know it, I’m heading back outside to get on with my day...
lines.zh: 不知不觉，我已经走出门外，继续我这一天了……
{i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]!{/i}
